subject.why: Yellow taxi is complete with the requested roof sign, checker pattern, and heart decal.

category.why: Background includes small houses on the horizon rather than just the street strip and sky.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or visible characters.

framing.why: Taxi is centrally positioned with appropriate margins and a low heroic angle.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm yellow body contrasts well against the saturated blue sky.

detail.why: Background contains extra architectural scenery elements not permitted by the category.

style.why: Matches reference style with chunky stylized shapes, soft lighting, and satin finish.

fix: Remove the houses along the horizon so the background consists solely of the road strip, clouds, and sky.
